memories.content:
Joplin codebase analysis:
- Monorepo using Yarn workspaces and Lerna
- Key packages: app-desktop (Electron), app-mobile (React Native), server (Node.js), lib (shared)
- Main scripts: buildParallel/buildSequential, test-ci, linter, tsc
- Development tools: ESLint, TypeScript, Jest, Gulp
- Architecture: Multi-platform (desktop/mobile/web/server/cli) with shared core library
